plate_comment: Processes a TSC1 (PGN 0) for the engine: the twin of CM848's processEngineTsc1Request (0x22d60). Byte 1 & 3 is the override control mode (SPN 695) and & 0x30 the priority (SPN 897); bytes 2-3 are the requested speed and byte 4 the requested torque. Rejects senders through cm550_diagnosticMessageValidator / cm550_diagnosticSessionValidator (the twins of CM848's ignored request and source configuration lookups) (was torqueControlModeHandler)
